7.name: TEXT_REGSAKPRESERVATIONLABOCOMMON_00949_SYSTEM_000_010
7.description: (-Personnel Protocols-)For security reasons, Containment Complex 10-29 has been registered as a materials distribution center. Keep this in mind and conduct yourself accordingly, both inside and outside the facility.

8.name: TEXT_REGSAKPRESERVATIONLABOCOMMON_00949_SYSTEM_000_011
8.description: (-Personnel Protocols-)Each employee must perform their tasks within their designated workrooms: the researchers' commons, the protolab, or the deuterolab. Entrance into another workroom without official clearance is strictly prohibited.

9.name: TEXT_REGSAKPRESERVATIONLABOCOMMON_00949_SYSTEM_000_012
9.description: (-Personnel Protocols-)Carry your security card at all times. Your clearance level dictates the areas to which you have access.

10.name: TEXT_REGSAKPRESERVATIONLABOCOMMON_00949_SYSTEM_000_013
10.description: (-Personnel Protocols-)Equip your regulator at all times. Due to the highly confidential nature of the research materials and other data managed within this complex, Preservation retains the ownership of─and the rights to modify─the memories of all registered personnel.

11.name: TEXT_REGSAKPRESERVATIONLABOCOMMON_00949_SYSTEM_000_020
11.description: (-Research Objectives-)Access denied. Please log in with your personnel account to view.

12.name: TEXT_REGSAKPRESERVATIONLABOCOMMON_00949_SYSTEM_000_025
12.description: (-Research Objectives-)The primary research objective of Containment Complex 10-29 is the indefinite preservation of the Endless.

13.name: TEXT_REGSAKPRESERVATIONLABOCOMMON_00949_SYSTEM_000_026
13.description: (-Research Objectives-)Continued improvements to soul cell and regulator functionality are intended to facilitate the Endless Sphene's management of Living Memory. It is via this process of iteration that we endeavor to identify and resolve any and all issues inherent in Endless creation.

14.name: TEXT_REGSAKPRESERVATIONLABOCOMMON_00949_SYSTEM_000_027
14.description: (-Research Objectives-)Chief among known issues is our present inability to control the key. For if we fail to secure the reflections as additional sources of aether, our ultimate goal will remain forever out of reach.
